LightningComponentBundle.description: Template or composite document selection UI with optional preset lock, embedding the docgen generator buttons. recordId and objectApiName are provided by the Lightning runtime on record pages.

property.name: objectLabel
property.label: Object Label
property.description: Display label used in lookup labels and messages (e.g. Quote). Defaults to a label derived from the object API name.

property.name: recordIdField
property.label: Record ID Field
property.description: Variable name for the record ID in composite generation (e.g. quoteId). Must match the record ID variable expected by the composite document.

property.name: previewBeforeSave
property.label: Preview Before Save
property.description: Show the generated file for review and require Save or Cancel before linking it to parent records

property.name: docgenType
property.label: Preset Document Type
property.description: Optional: 'template' or 'composite'. With Preset Document Name, locks the selection to that document.

property.name: docgenName
property.label: Preset Document Name
property.description: Optional: name of the template, or composite document number/description. Locks the selection when a match is found.

property.name: hideFilePicker
property.label: Hide Additional PDF Picker
property.description: Hide the additional PDF file picker. Attachments can still be preset via additionalPdfContentVersionIds.
